changes: Rendered view: your interior through the game's own shaders and lighting, at the time of day and weather you pick (Shading popover). The Game workspace opens in it, with a Render settings panel (time, weather, exposure, timecycle, side-by-side compare).
Walk mode (Shift+`): walk through your interior at eye height with WASD and the mouse.
Real peds: the ped you place is an actual game ped (Michael by default, or any of 1,119 by search). Editor only, not exported.

Test in FiveM (F5): the editor runs a local FiveM server for you (Legacy or Enhanced, to match your export), exports and drops you at your first ped. It asks before the first download and needs a free server key from portal.cfx.re (Preferences > Test server). The server only runs on your own PC and shuts down with the editor; My own server still works.

One keymap, Blender style: middle-drag orbits; G / R / S move, rotate and scale (X / Y / Z locks an axis, type a number for exact amounts); X deletes, Shift+A adds, Shift+D duplicates; right-click opens the context menu or cancels. The status bar shows which keys do what right now.

Split views: up to four viewports, each with its own camera and shading (Ctrl+Alt+Q for quad view). A navigation gizmo (top right) for exact front / side / top views. Global / Local / View orientation in the header.
Snapping you can see: a line and a label show what you're snapping to, and things dragged over a corner or vertex land exactly on it.

New look: Select, Move / Rotate / Scale, then six categories (Build, Openings, Surfaces, Furnish, Light, Game); right-click a category for its tools, every tool keeps its key. The Catalogue (Window > Catalogue) holds everything you can add, with pictures. Properties in tabs: Project, Levels, Object, Game; Preferences only holds your personal settings.
Search boxes match words in any order: 'metal black' finds black_metal_01.
Kitchens (Shift+Q): drag along a wall and a full kitchen fills itself in (units, corner units, a sink under the window, a hob, worktop and wall units), or place unit by unit, or build an island.
Furniture: sofas, armchairs, tables, chairs and stools from 21 presets, adjustable in Properties and exported with collision.
Pillows and blankets (Alt+K): drop one and it drapes over whatever is below it; Keep this pose stops the fall at any moment.
Garage doors (roller, sectional, up-and-over, shutter, or one of the game's 16), more door presets, handles, finishes and extras.

Windows: sash, casement, arched and shop front, with glazing bars, frame finishes, glass looks, sills, lintels and window seats. Window coverings: Roman, vertical, cellular and bamboo blinds, plantation shutters, security grilles; curtains get headings, tie-backs, poles and sheers.

Stairs: cut string, open risers, mono stringer and floating treads, carpet runners and lights under the steps. Railings: glass, metal, cable, balusters, parapet, rope and chain, mesh, wall rail. Ladders match the game's exactly, in 7 styles. More room trims (picture rail, wainscot, ceiling beams).

Light fittings: 29 of them, all adjustable, or one of the game's own lamps. Cove lighting along a room's walls. Picture frames and galleries around decals and mirrors. Style materials: frosted and tinted glass, glowing panels, neon, screens.
Paint preview: see what a click will paint before you click, and drag a rectangle to paint part of a wall. Hold Shift over a style or material to see it in place.
Props land on tables, shelves and seats; wall props hang where you point and face the right way against a wall.
Your own sounds (.wav) on doors and sound emitters. The export draws a radar minimap of your interior.
No more clashing: curtains clear the trims, lights mount under beams; anything left out is explained in the Problems panel.

Faster: drawing walls and railings no longer lags; rebuilds, exports, loading and saving several times faster on big projects; switching to Rendered, searching and resizing doors no longer freeze. Material changes update in the background. Overlays > Statistics shows fps, triangles, draw calls and export size.
Clean export: writes only what your interior uses and clears out files from earlier exports (never your own files).
Fixed: flickering rugs and custom textures (imported pictures are resized to sizes the game loads; re-export).
Fixed: a gap beside custom doors (doorways now match the door; older projects fix themselves when opened; save and re-export).
Fixed: the camera went through curtains and blinds (you can still walk through).

Fixed: the test server mistaking a working key for a refused one, the first game prop in a new project failing to load, inside-out glTF exports, lights stuck under a raised ceiling, a crash on undo then delete, G refusing some objects, stair rails losing their style on load, thin seams at wall feet and tops.

Known issue: hot reloading an interior (F5 again while you're in game) doesn't work yet, because of a limitation in how the stream clearing command works. It's being investigated and will be patched soon.
Not tried in game yet: garage doors, and the rug, door gap and curtain fixes. Let us know how they look!
Props take the light of their room (sky through the windows, ambient, lamps, a contact shadow): on in new projects, set in Game > Vertex colours or per prop.
Collision for props that have none (boxes, or a mesh as the last resort): on in new projects, set in Game > Prop collision or per model.
A tidier tool column: Railing with Wall, Ladder with Stairs, and new Mirror, particle effect, sound emitter and ped spawn point buttons.
Shift+A is the Add menu: Mesh, Effects, Lighting and mirrors, Collision (Edit > Add is the same).
Breakable glass works in game: it cracks and shatters like the 24/7 shops' windows (the crash, the freeze and the second unbroken pane are fixed; re-export).
Hanging cloth is switched off for now (Preferences > Interface > Experimental: hanging cloth): it doesn't hang properly in game yet.
Fixed: game props, game doors and custom doors had no collision in game (re-export your interior).
Fixed: floor and ceiling dirt made hard bands beside windows and doors; it now fades out smoothly before them.
Fixed: a clean slit in the dirt, and a crack in the editor's walls, where two walls meet almost in line.
Fixed: window and door frames, glass and sill boards were missing from outside the interior.
Fixed: louvre window slats stuck out of their frame at an angle.
Fixed: game props and doors that didn't load in game: each is now exported as a copy under the resource's name, with its own texture dictionary.
Props and doors from the game are kept in the project's Assets/Game folder, so a project moved to another computer still finds them.
GTA V Enhanced: export for Legacy, Enhanced or both in one resource (Export > Game).
Linux (beta): Modlo Creator runs on Linux as an AppImage and finds GTA V in Steam (Proton), Lutris, Heroic, Bottles or Wine.
Walk-in buildings: a preview of the building before you pick it, and the models it comes with (decals, glass, props) included, left out or removed from the map.
Walk-in buildings: occluders and the game's floor inside your rooms are cleared on export, so nothing hides or shows through your interior.
Walk-in buildings: Make openings for several marks at once, Keep marks upright, and doors and windows that snap to the building's openings.
Explode points: a new shell tool that casts rays inside a building and builds square walls, doors and windows from the corners you click.
Mirror modifier: build one half and mirror it across X and/or Y.
Wall heights follow the ceiling; cornices follow sloped walls; doors and windows go as high as their own wall.
New handles for floor cuts, zones, railings, ladders, stairs, lights, spawn points, decals, mesh scale and sills.
Number fields work like Blender's, UI scale presets for 1080p to 5K, and Show the keys pressed for recording tutorials.
Experimental: hanging cloth the game simulates, and breakable window glass.
Fixed: custom doors had no collision and never swung in game (re-export older projects).
Fixed: a walk-in doorway cut a hole into the ground in front of the door.
Fixed: a mirror didn't show the door of its room (not yet checked in game), Array... showed twice with several props selected, dirt along the floor vanished under windows.
First release.
